description: Synthetic fixture matrix for 6 known bad-bundle patterns

patterns.name: zero_bytes_source_diff
patterns.trigger: git diff HEAD > source-diff.patch when no tracked changes
patterns.fix: Write explanatory text into source-diff.patch when diff output is empty

patterns.name: missing_evidence_category
patterns.description: A required ECC category file path does not exist on disk
patterns.trigger: evidence-contract.json references a file that was never created
patterns.fix: Create all required files before running ECC; verify list matches contract

patterns.name: phantom_sha_in_manifest
patterns.description: bundle-manifest.json references a commit SHA that does not exist in git history
patterns.fix: Run git cat-file -t <sha> to verify SHA exists before writing manifest

patterns.name: stale_placeholder_in_proof
patterns.description: final-clean-proof.txt committed with 'This file will be updated' placeholder
patterns.ecc_expected: PRESENT (file exists, ECC passes — semantic validator catches it)
patterns.trigger: 3-commit pattern step 2 committed before replacing placeholder
patterns.fix: Apply PROOF-TEMPLATE-001 rule; use [to be captured in step 3] token instead
patterns.observed_in: Final Publication Sprint commit 0f5b09c (resolved in adcf3dc)

patterns.name: ecc_key_mismatch
patterns.description: evidence-contract.json uses wrong field names (e.g. 'present_count' vs 'present')
patterns.trigger: Reading ECC output JSON with wrong key name
patterns.fix: Use 'present', not 'present_count'; verify against ECC source output schema

patterns.name: bundle_file_not_read_before_write
patterns.description: Write tool error: 'File has not been read yet' when overwriting existing file
patterns.trigger: Attempting Write on existing file without first calling Read
patterns.fix: Always call Read before Write on existing files

regression_baseline: Healing Sprint 1 — all 6 patterns documented with fixes
